$comment:
v1.0 §16 MVP: one safe region and one high-risk region. REQ-ZON-001 fixes the four danger tiers: BLUE cannot kill, YELLOW injures, RED injures severely, BLACK can kill. Both regions here are procedurally routed within a fixed world (REQ-EXP-001) — the nodes below are the *pool* a route is drawn from, not a fixed path.

v1.0 §8 makes the map a knowledge interface. `knowledgeTier` is the guild's starting knowledge; discovery advances it and is permanent (REQ-WLD-001).

regions.name: The Verdant Reach
regions.description: Overgrown lowland within a day of the gate. The guild has walked it a hundred times.

regions.name: The Ashfall Barrows
regions.description: Burial terraces under a permanent fall of warm ash. Hunters come back from here changed, or not at all.

nodeKinds.$comment: REQ-EXP-002: expeditions have branching routes, events, combat, exploration and decisions. The prototype implements combat, rest and discovery nodes plus a boss; the event catalogue is Phase 5 content.
